alex_sales: FYI Vertex Health SIG is due EOD Friday. They flagged Q7 (encryption at rest) and Q12 (third-party subprocessors). Need artifacts by tomorrow morning. Can security + SE pair on this?
marie_se: I can pull the KMS rotation doc and config snippets. tagging @sam_security for policy confirmation. I’ll upload to artifacts bucket and share links.
sam_security: On it. I’ll validate the KMS rotation schedule and key IDs. Also need to confirm HSM usage for Private deployments — is Vertex on Dedicated or Private?
alex_sales: Customer said Private/VPC. They want HSM or customer-managed KMS proof.
jenna_cs: Customer asked for redacted logs only (no PII). We have the redaction policy doc, will confirm retention window.
marie_se: Quick plan: I’ll create a mapping file that ties SIG question numbers to artifacts. Example mapping lines I’ll use: 
- Q7 -> redwood-kms-rotation-2025.pdf, kms-policy-2026-02-15.md
- Q12 -> subproc-list-2026-03.csv, dpa-template-signed.pdf
I’ll upload to artifacts and post links.
alex_sales: Perfect. If you can paste the artifact links here I’ll send to Vertex security. Keep filenames customer-friendly.
marie_se: Uploaded initial set: 
https://artifacts.internal.redwood/vertex/sig/redwood-kms-rotation-2025.pdf
https://artifacts.internal.redwood/vertex/sig/kms-policy-2026-02-15.md
https://artifacts.internal.redwood/vertex/sig/subproc-list-2026-03.csv
https://artifacts.internal.redwood/vertex/sig/dpa-template-signed.pdf
(permissions set to vertex-security@vertexhealth.com) :white_check_mark:
sam_security: I ran a quick check against our key rotation schedule. KMS key alias: alias/redwood-prod, rotation: 90d, last-rotated: 2026-01-10. I’ll attach the audit snippet.
integration-bot: vulnerability-scan/2026-03-20 completed for model-serving. Findings: 0 critical, 2 medium (fixes in next patch). Report: https://artifacts.internal.redwood/vertex/sig/orca-scan-report-2026-03-20.json
marie_se: Pasting the minimal evidence bundle we plan to send (one message copyable):
---BEGIN EVIDENCE BUNDLE---
Q7 (Encryption at rest): redwood-kms-rotation-2025.pdf, kms-policy-2026-02-15.md, storage-encryption-config.txt
Q12 (Third-party subprocessors): subproc-list-2026-03.csv, dpa-template-signed.pdf, vendor-security-assessments/secure-vendor-2025.pdf
Network isolation: private-network-diagram.png, vpc-peering-config.txt
Access controls: iam-roles-audit-2026-02.csv, mfa-enforcement-policy.md
---END EVIDENCE BUNDLE---
sam_security: Two notes: 1) redact service account IDs in iam-roles-audit before sharing; 2) include proof of KMS key rotation (CloudTrail snippet). I created cloudtrail-kms-activity-2026-02-logs.json and uploaded.
marie_se: Will redact and produce a zip: vertex-sig-evidence-redacted-2026.zip. ETA 2 hours.
jenna_cs: Also confirm we’re not including any raw customer data. I’ll double-check the scan report to ensure PII was not captured.
sam_security: Confirmed no PII in scan. I’ll add a signed statement from security: "No customer data included in artifacts" and attach signature.
alex_sales: Great. Once redacted bundle is ready, I’ll run through Vertex’s SIG portal and submit. One ask from their security: they want a short mapping doc (one page) that points each SIG question to the artifact and the page/section. Can we do that?
marie_se: Yes. I’ll generate a "SIG quick map" PDF with bullets linking each Q -> artifact URL + page refs.
integration-bot: access-log: artifact vertex-sig-evidence-redacted-2026.zip downloaded by alex_sales at 1799460200
alex_sales: Thanks everyone — I’ll submit once the quick map and redacted bundle are attached. If there are any blockers ping me immediately. :pray:
sam_security: If Vertex asks about BYOK/HSM we’ll provide the HSM attestation and KMS config. I’ll prep the attestation doc now.
marie_se: Uploading redacted zip and quick-map now... https://artifacts.internal.redwood/vertex/sig/vertex-sig-evidence-redacted-2026.zip
https://artifacts.internal.redwood/vertex/sig/vertex-sig-quick-map-2026.pdf
alex_sales: Submitted via their portal and emailed contact (security@vertexhealth.com). Sending copy to thread.
jenna_cs: Marking as handed off to sales for any follow ups. :white_check_mark:
alex_sales: Closing the loop — Vertex acknowledged receipt and requested an SLA excerpt for Dedicated tenancy. I’ll open a new thread for SLA excerpt follow-up. Thanks all. :tada:
